description: This file defines a public enum 'BonjourServiceResolverSupport' with static utility methods for resolving NetService instances and normalizing host strings, specifically used for Bonjour service resolution support.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Schedules the NetService on the main run loop and initiates resolution with a default timeout.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newline characters from a raw host string and removes a trailing dot if present.
